name: fuzzycomplete
description: Add fuzzy Tab completion to the DuckDB CLI. Find SQL keywords and table names from abbreviated input, including names in attached databases.

cta.title: Smarter CLI Autocomplete
cta.description: Install fuzzycomplete in the DuckDB CLI for VS-Code-style fuzzy autocomplete that crosses database and schema boundaries.

quickStart.title: Enable fuzzy completion in the CLI
quickStart.description: Load the extension and create a sample table. Then use the CLI’s Tab key to complete its name.
quickStart.sql:
CREATE TEMP TABLE customer_orders (id INTEGER);

-- At the next CLI prompt, type SELECT * FROM cust and press Tab.
quickStart.requirements: Use the interactive DuckDB CLI. This example was checked with DuckDB 1.5.6 and Fuzzycomplete build `8b89b19` from the community repository. If you installed it previously, [update and verify completion](#update-and-verify-completion) first.
quickStart.note: Tab completion is an interactive action, so there is no query-result table here. Loading this extension in Python, JDBC, or another embedded client does not add a CLI input loop.

introduction.title: Complete abbreviated names while writing SQL
paragraphs: Fuzzycomplete changes Tab completion in the interactive DuckDB CLI. It ranks keywords and identifiers by how well they match the characters you typed, including abbreviated names and characters at word boundaries.

Use it when you explore unfamiliar schemas or work across several attached databases. Suggestions can include qualified names from those catalogs. It changes the CLI’s input experience; for comparing strings stored in tables, use [RapidFuzz](/products/extensions/rapidfuzz/) instead.
